title: Shuba: Multi-tenant Marketplace
description: Full-featured multi-tenant SaaS e-commerce platform with database isolation and dynamic store customization per tenant.

technicalDetails.architecture: Modular monolithic architecture with a database router for subdomain-based multi-tenancy.
technicalDetails.challenges: Managing dynamic database schema migrations for each new tenant without causing downtime.

title: TravYotei - Integrated Mobility
description: Unified web portal for intercity trip booking with real-time bus status synchronization.

technicalDetails.architecture: Hybrid SSR/SSG rendering for optimal SEO performance combined with persistent sockets.
technicalDetails.challenges: Handling concurrent seat locking by multiple clients on the same bus.

title: AI Recommendation Engine
description: Book recommendation API based on behavioral analysis and collaborative filtering.

technicalDetails.architecture: Decoupled microservice exposing prediction models through a secured REST API.
technicalDetails.challenges: Optimizing cosine similarity matrix computation to handle queries under 100ms.

title: API-Rsv-TravYotei Microservices
description: High-throughput distributed booking engine leveraging event streaming to guarantee eventual consistency.

technicalDetails.architecture: Event-driven microservices with full decoupling via message queues.
technicalDetails.challenges: Guaranteeing idempotent message processing in Kafka during network node failures.

title: QUORX: System Instinct
description: An immersive system simulation and graphical educational game designed to train core computer engineering reflexes (process management, memory, networking, and security).

technicalDetails.architecture: Modular architecture driven by a Core Engine coupled with a real-time simulation engine (CPU, Memory, Network, Security) and an asynchronous random incident generator.
technicalDetails.challenges: Accurately modeling and visually representing complex system behaviors (memory leaks, CPU spikes, network anomalies) within ultra-short 30-to-90-second gameplay loops.
